description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Instant Cast 1], [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)], [Buff Prismatic 20% (15s)] to all allies if 4+ FF1 allies are alive, grants [Instant Cast 1], [Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)] too all allies if 2-3 FF1 allies are alive, grants [Instant Cast 1], [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to user if 0-1 FF1 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Witch], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)] to the user

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Buff Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 20% (15s)], [Buff Ice 20% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)], [Buff Earth 20% (15s)], [Buff Wind 20% (15s)], [Buff Water 20% (15s)], [Buff Holy 20% (15s)], [Buff Dark 20% (15s)] and [Buff Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)], [Buff Earth 10% (15s)], [Buff Wind 10% (15s)], [Buff Water 10% (15s)], [Buff Holy 10% (15s)], [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] and [Buff Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Awoken Witch
description.text: Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability
